en.headline: Police arrest two men after queue dispute turns into fight at Shau Kei Wan bus terminus
en.dek: Officers detained a 68-year-old man and a 50-year-old man on suspicion of fighting in a public place after a brawl broke out among passengers waiting for a Citybus Route 9 service on Monday morning.
body: Police arrested two men on Monday after a dispute over queuing escalated into a fight at the Shau Kei Wan bus terminus.

A bus captain reported the incident around 10:23am at the Citybus Route 9 stop toward Shek O. Officers believe two men argued over their places in the queue and then began fighting. A 68-year-old man surnamed So was later arrested at a shopping centre on Oi Yin Street, and a 50-year-old man surnamed Chan was arrested at a housing estate on Baker Street in Hung Hom. Both were detained on suspicion of fighting in a public place.

Citybus said several passengers were suspected of arguing while queuing at the terminus waiting area and that frontline staff immediately sought police assistance. The company noted it had deployed extra staff at major stops during the Chung Yeung holiday and that services remained largely normal. The Eastern District crime investigation team is following up the case.

zh.headline: 筱箕灣巴士總站排隊糾紛爆衝突 兩男子涉公眾地方打鬥被捕
zh.dek: 警方周一早上在城巴9號線往石澳方向站頭接報，其後拘捕一名68歲男子及一名50歲男子，涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥。
body: 警方周一拘捕兩名男子，他們涉嫌在筱箕灣巴士總站因排隊問題發生爭執後打鬥。
城巴車長約上午10時23分報案，指愛秩序街城巴9號線往石澳方向站頭有乘客打鬥。警方調查後相信兩名男子因排隊問題爭執，其後動手。警方其後在愛賢街一商場拘捕一名68歲姓蘇男子，並在紅碩必嘉街一屋苑拘捕一名50歲姓陳男子，兩人均涉嫌在公眾地方打鬥，正被扣留調查。
城巴表示，當時有數名乘客在筱箕灣巴士總站候車處排隊期間懷疑發生爭執，前線職員隨即尋求警方協助。公司指重陽節假期期間已在主要巴士站加派人手，服務大致正常。案件由東區警區刑事調查隊跟進。
